name: Hoshino Asuka
source:
Asuka lives in Yokohama (横浜), Kanagawa and goes to Seika Girls High School (清華女子高校) where she is a third year student in class B.

She likes playing the crane games at game centers, and works part time as a waitress at a family restaurant.
